name: wah-lah
description: WAH-LAH monorepo — FastAPI backend (Render) + React frontend (Vercel) + MongoDB Atlas, fronted by a Cloudflare Worker API proxy

scripts.backend:install: if [ ! -x backend/.venv/bin/python ]; then python3.12 -m venv backend/.venv; fi && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.install: npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:install
scripts.start: npm run backend:run & npm run frontend:start
